summary: Harmony Gold Mining furnished a Form 6-K (the US analogue of a foreign private issuer's disclosure report) on 13 October 2026, disclosing off-market awards of deferred ordinary shares to executive directors, the company secretary and prescribed officers under the 2018 Harmony Deferred Share Plan. Awards were struck at a five-day volume-weighted average price of R323.28 per share on 18 September 2026 and accepted 8 October 2026, with 270,000-odd shares issued across nine individuals and vesting in five equal annual tranches. This is routine executive remuneration and director-dealing disclosure mandated by JSE Listings Requirements, not a special situation.
